004605: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL IrTypeId c_ir_type_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end);
004606: 
004607: // May the parenthesized group opening at `open` spell a type name?  False
004608: // only when the token after the `(` proves it cannot, without entering the
004609: // query machine.  c_ir_type_name_prefix accepts a type name that begins with
004610: // a type, qualifier, tag, typeof or _Atomic keyword, a decoration
004611: // c_ir_primitive_type_kind steps over (an attribute, an asm label, a `[[`
004612: // attribute) or an identifier naming a typedef, and nothing else, so:
004613: // - a number, a string, a character and every punctuator but `[` is refused
004614: //   outright;
004615: // - an identifier the parser bound to a local, object, parameter,
004616: //   enumerator or function is refused too: the prefix reads that binding
004617: //   before any scope lookup, and none of them is a typedef.  Its spelling
004618: //   must not be one of the keywords above, which
004619: //   c_parse_type_name_start_word_token answers from the word bits (an
004620: //   interned spelling outside the predefined range is no keyword; symbol 0
004621: //   is unclassified and stays a candidate).
004622: // An unbound identifier keeps the scope-chain lookup the probe does for it,
004623: // and a typedef is the candidate the probe exists for.
004624: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_group_may_be_type_name(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open)
004625: {
004626:     bool result = true;
004627:     if (open + 1 < builder->preprocess.token_count)
004628:     {
004629:         CToken first = builder->preprocess.tokens[open + 1];
004630:         if (first.kind != C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
004631:         {
004632:             result = first.punctuator == C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET;
004633:         }
004634:         else if (first.symbol && !c_parse_type_name_start_word_token(builder->preprocess, first))
004635:         {
004636:             CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, open + 1);
004637:             if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count)
004638:             {
004639:                 CEntityKind kind = builder->parse.entities[entity.value].kind;
004640:                 result = kind != C_ENTITY_LOCAL && kind != C_ENTITY_OBJECT && kind != C_ENTITY_PARAMETER && kind != C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR &&
004641:                          kind != C_ENTITY_FUNCTION;
004642:             }
004643:         }
004644:     }
004645:     return result;
004646: }

004651: // time.

004653: {
004654:     u32* slot = 0;

004656:     {
004657:         slot = builder->group_type_names + (open - builder->body_token_start);

004662: // Whether a probe's answer for the group `open .. close` may be stored.  A
004663: // group headed by typeof/__typeof__/__typeof/typeof_unqual reads the locals
004664: // declared so far, so its answer can change between two probes; a lone
004665: // identifier the parser left unbound is looked up at file scope by
004666: // c_ir_type_name and at the declaration's scope by the query, so the two
004667: // probe paths may not share one answer for it.  Everything else is a
004668: // function of the tokens and the parse alone.
004669: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_group_type_name_memoizable(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 open, u32 close)
004670: {
004671:     bool result = true;
004672:     CToken first = builder->preprocess.tokens[open + 1];
004673:     if (first.kind == C_TOKEN_IDENTIFIER)
004674:     {
004675:         String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, first);
004676:         if (string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__typeof__")) || string_equal(spelling, S8("__typeof")) ||
004677:             string_equal(spelling, S8("typeof_unqual")))
004678:         {
004679:             result = false;
004680:         }
004681:         else if (close == open + 2 && c_ir_identifier_entity(builder, open + 1).value == C_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
004682:         {
004683:             result = false;
004684:         }
004685:     }
004686:     return result;
004687: }

025416: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_sizeof_operand_identifier_type_attempt(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end, IrTypeId* type_out, bool promote_bit_fields)
025417: {
025418:     CToken token = builder->preprocess.tokens[start];
025419:     String8 name = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token);
025420:     u32 chain_start = start + 1;
025421: 
025422:     // Builtin math names are parser symbols rather than ordinary declarations,
025423:     // so they have no CEntity/signature for the strict type walk to query.
025424:     // Resolve their result type directly and consume the call suffix.  This
025425:     // matters for hosted headers where NAN/INFINITY expand to a conditional
025426:     // expression containing __builtin_nanf/__builtin_inff: treating the
025427:     // builtin as an unknown identifier poisons the conditional's type merge
025428:     // even though lowering already knows the intrinsic's scalar result.
025429:     String8 math_link_name = c_ir_math_builtin_link_name(name);
025430:     if (math_link_name.length)
025431:     {
025432:         if (chain_start >= end || !c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[chain_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
025433:         {
025434:             return false;
025435:         }
025436:         u32 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, chain_start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
025437:         if (close >= end)
025438:         {
025439:             return false;
025440:         }
025441:         bool predicate = string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isnan")) || string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isnanf")) ||
025442:                          string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isinf")) || string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isinff")) ||
025443:                          string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isinf_sign")) || string_equal(math_link_name, S8("isfinite"));
025444:         bool single = math_link_name.length && math_link_name.pointer[math_link_name.length - 1] == 'f';
025445:         *type_out = predicate ? builder->s32_type : single ? builder->f32_type : builder->f64_type;
025446:         return c_ir_sizeof_operand_postfix_chain_attempt(builder, type_out, close + 1, end, promote_bit_fields);
025447:     }
025448: 
025449:     CEntityId entity = c_ir_identifier_entity_or_lookup(builder, start);
025450:     CIntegerIrLocal* local = c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity);
025451:     IrTypeId type = IR_TYPE_ID_INVALID;
025452:     if (local)
025453:     {
025454:         if (local->is_variable_length_array)
025455:         {
025456:             return false;
025457:         }
025458:         type = local->type;
025459:     }
025460:     else if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count && builder->parse.entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_ENUMERATOR)
025461:     {
025462:         type = builder->s32_type;
025463:     }
025464:     else if (entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count && builder->parse.entities[entity.value].kind == C_ENTITY_OBJECT)
025465:     {
025466:         CTypeId c_type = builder->parse.entities[entity.value].type;
025467:         if (c_type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
025468:         {
025469:             type = builder->c_type_ir_map[c_type.value];
025470:         }
025471:     }
025472:     if (type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && chain_start < end &&
025473:         c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[chain_start], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS))
025474:     {
025475:         // A direct call through a function name resolves to the declared return type.
025476:         CIrPreparedCall* prepared_call = c_ir_prepared_call_find(builder, start);
025477:         u32 close = UINT32_MAX;
025478:         if (prepared_call && builder->function && prepared_call->emitted && prepared_call->result.value < builder->function->value_count)
025479:         {
025480:             type = builder->function->values[prepared_call->result.value].canonical_type;
025481:             close = prepared_call->close_index;
025482:         }
025483:         else
025484:         {
025485:             u32 declaration_index = c_ir_find_function(builder, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token));
025486:             if (declaration_index != UINT32_MAX && builder->signatures)
025487:             {
025488:                 type = builder->signatures[declaration_index].return_type;
025489:                 close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, chain_start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
025490:             }
025491:             else if (declaration_index != UINT32_MAX && declaration_index < builder->parse.declaration_count)
025492:             {
025493:                 // No signatures exist while the type-mapping fixed point
025494:                 // evaluates array bounds, and a bound like
025495:                 // `char buffer[sizeof(helper())]` that fails here classifies
025496:                 // the local as a VLA — which a static local then rejects.
025497:                 // Resolve the declared return type through the parse
025498:                 // declaration instead; an unmapped return type still fails,
025499:                 // deferring the bound to a later mapping round rather than
025500:                 // guessing.
025501:                 CDeclaration* function_declaration = &builder->parse.declarations[declaration_index];
025502:                 if (function_declaration->type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
025503:                 {
025504:                     CType* function_type = &builder->parse.types[function_declaration->type.value];
025505:                     if (function_type->kind == C_TYPE_FUNCTION && function_type->return_type.value < builder->parse.type_count)
025506:                     {
025507:                         type = builder->c_type_ir_map[function_type->return_type.value];
025508:                     }
025509:                 }
025510:                 if (type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
025511:                 {
025512:                     close = c_ir_matching_delimiter_cached(builder, chain_start, end, C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_PARENTHESIS, C_PUNCTUATOR_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS);
025513:                 }
025514:             }
025515:         }
025516:         if (close >= end)
025517:         {
025518:             return false;
025519:         }
025520:         chain_start = close + 1;
025521:     }
025522:     else if (type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
025523:     {
025524:         // A bare function name resolves to its function type so a call applied
025525:         // through parentheses, e.g. `(name)(...)`, still reaches the return type.
025526:         u32 declaration_index = c_ir_find_function(builder, c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, token));
025527:         if (declaration_index != UINT32_MAX && builder->declaration_functions && builder->declaration_functions[declaration_index])
025528:         {
025529:             type = builder->declaration_functions[declaration_index]->canonical_type;
025530:         }
025531:     }
025532:     if (type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
025533:     {
025534:         return false;
025535:     }
025536:     *type_out = type;
025537:     return c_ir_sizeof_operand_postfix_chain_attempt(builder, type_out, chain_start, end, promote_bit_fields);
025538: }

025540: /* Resolves the C result type of a sizeof/alignof expression operand strictly: every
025541:    sub-operand must resolve through a mapped entity, literal, cast, or call before any
025542:    type is combined, and binary operators apply the usual arithmetic conversions (so
025543:    narrow operands promote to int and mixed widths take the wider side). Returning

043164:             IrTypeId function_type = builder->c_type_ir_map[entity->type.value];
043165:             IrTypeId pointer_type = c_ir_add_pointer_type(builder->program, builder->pointer_types, function_type);
043166:             if (pointer_type.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID)
043167:             {
043168:                 *result = (CIrConstantValue){
043169:                     .type = pointer_type,
043170:                     .symbol = builder->entity_symbols[entity_id.value],
043171:                     .kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER,
043172:                 };
043173:                 return result->symbol.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID;
043174:             }
043175:         }
043176:     }
043177: 
043178:     return false;
043179: }
043180: 
043181: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_lvalue_field(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantValue* value, String8 name)
043182: {
043183:     if (value->kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN)
043184:     {
043185:         return true;
043186:     }
043187:     IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
043188:     if (type && (type->kind == IR_TYPE_STRUCT || type->kind == IR_TYPE_UNION))
043189:     {
043190:         for (u32 field_index = 0; field_index < type->field_count; field_index += 1)
043191:         {
043192:             IrField* field = type->fields + field_index;
043193:             if (!string_equal(field->name, name))
043194:             {
043195:                 continue;
043196:             }
043197:             if (field->offset > INT64_MAX || value->addend > INT64_MAX - (s64)field->offset)
043198:             {
043199:                 return false;
043200:             }
043201:             value->type = field->type;
043202:             value->addend += (s64)field->offset;
043203:             value->kind = C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE;
043204:             return true;
043205:         }
043206:     }
043207: 
043208:     return false;
043209: }
043210: 
043211: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_index(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantValue* value, u64 index)
043212: {
043213:     if (value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_UNKNOWN)
043214:     {
043215:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value->type);
043216:         if (!type || (value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_LVALUE && value->kind != C_IR_CONSTANT_POINTER) ||
043217:             (type->kind != IR_TYPE_ARRAY && type->kind != IR_TYPE_POINTER))
043218:         {
043219:             return false;
043220:         }
043221:         IrType* element = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type->element_type);
043222:         if (!element || !element->layout.resolved || element->layout.size > INT64_MAX || index > (u64)INT64_MAX / BUSTER_MAX((u64)1, element->layout.size))
043223:         {
043224:             return false;
043225:         }
043226:         s64 offset = (s64)(index * element->layout.size);
